mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ich_post_favorite (post_id, user_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ich_post_favorite WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ich_post_favorite WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.user_name, p.user_avatar, p.title, p.content, p.images, p.video_url, p.cover_image, p.tags, p.type, p.like_count, p.favorite_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM ich_post_favorite f INNER JOIN ich_post p ON f.post_id = p.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ich_post_favorite f INNER JOIN ich_post p ON f.post_id = p.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
